text.description_html:
Emtek 1645, 2 x 10 Tuscan Multi Point Trim with Door Configuration #6

The Bronze Tuscany 2 x 10 Multi Point Trim Set features Emtek's multipoint door configuration #6--which means the American Cylinder Hub is below the handle with a 3-5/8 inch center to center. This patio door handleset is available in a wide selection of functions for something that will suit your application. The Tuscany Style Multi Point Trim with American Cylinder is made out of cast bronze and is available in flat black or medium bronze finishes. Choose from several Tuscan inspired door levers for the trim.

This multipoint trim set is intended to replace the trim from Milgard and Pella brand patio doors. The lock to lever distance is 3-5/8" (92 mm). This set does not come packaged with the multipoint lock mechanism (the vertical rods found in multipoint patio doors that secure the door to the frame) as those are typically preinstalled in multipoint doors and cannot be replaced.

Features and Specifications of the Bronze Tuscany Multi Point Trim with American Cylinder Below Handle:

  • Material: Lost Wax Cast Bronze
  • Overall Height: 10"
  • Overall Width: 2"
  • Distance Between Trim and Cylinder or Thumbturn (for Keyed, Passage, and Patio Functions): 3-5/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 8-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: 3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-5/8" - 2-3/4" please specify.
  • Solid steel spindle.
  • Emtek 1645 Dimensions (PDF)

Available Functions:

  • Dummy Pair, Active (inside): Active lever inside with fixed inactive lever outside. For use as a pull or to match trim. Normally used on inactive French door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles and mounting screws.
  • Dummy Pair, Inactive: Fixed inactive levers both sides of door. For use as a pull or to match trim. Normally used on inactive French door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles and mounting screws.
  • Passage: Active levers both sides of door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, and mounting screws.
  • Patio: Active levers both sides of door. Thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, One (1) interior thumb turn and mounting screws.
  • Keyed Entry: Active levers both sides of door. Keyed lock cylinder outside with thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, Two (2) cylinder collars, One (1) american profile cylinder with key outside & thumb turn inside and mounting screws.

Choose any of the different levers to complete your handleset.
